_help: The Refunds and delivery page (Razorpay asks for refund and delivery policies). Plain-English draft: have a lawyer check it.
title: Refunds and delivery
intro: How you get what you paid for, and when you can get your money back.

sections.title: Delivery
list: Everything we sell is digital. Nothing is shipped.
Reports, certificates, exports and books appear in your account under Purchases right after payment, with a download button. We also email you a receipt.
If your download does not appear within 30 minutes, contact us with your payment reference.

sections.title: Digital products (reports, certificates, exports, books)
list: Because they are delivered straight away, digital products are not refundable once downloaded.
If a file is broken, wrong or never arrived, tell us within 7 days and we will fix it or refund you in full.

sections.title: Project listings (Academy courses and custom toys)
list: Payment does not guarantee listing. Every project passes our vetting checklist first, and we refund in full if we decline.
If you cancel before we start work, we refund in full. Once work has started, we refund the part not yet done.
No refund once a course or toy is live.

sections.title: Calls
list: Cancel or move a call at least 24 hours before it starts for a full refund or a new time.
Later cancellations and missed calls are not refunded.
If we have to cancel, you get a full refund or a new time, your choice.

sections.title: How refunds are paid
list: Refunds go back to the card, UPI or account you paid with, usually within 5 to 7 working days after we approve them.

Crypto payments are refunded in the same coin and network, to a wallet address you send us, for the US dollar value you paid, minus the network fee. Crypto sent to a wrong address or on a wrong network cannot be recovered.
